title: Core Quintet #46
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 5:4 aspect ratio, five women in a single row.

A photograph of FIVE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 5 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, long black hair in twin tails tied with pink and black ribbons under a blunt fringe, a hollow, dreamy expression, bold and confident, curly hair, real living eyes. Long almond nails, holographic finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel — a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense cloisonné floral wirework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme gold extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Swedish woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, long straight platinum-blonde hair, a cool, calm, faraway expression, bold and confident, twin-tail hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, chrome finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow.
